column1: # content: the models whose spectra are computed: three equal rates of deflation with the total rate gsum
column2: Newton's constant G_N(x4) = G_N(today) exp(gsum (x4 - x4_today)) (assumptions A1
column4: perturbations under assumption A3 with the closure "Momentum" (suffix _M) or "Pressure" (suffix _P); the Hubble constant of each model is the one for which the angle theta_* of the sound horizon at last scattering has its value without deflation; the densities of baryons and of cold dark matter
column5: the primordial amplitude and tilt and the optical depth are those of the fiducial model of the main project

column1: # columns: gsum_over_H0: gsum in units of 67.36 km/s/Mpc; gsum_per_yr; H0: Hubble constant in km/s/Mpc; dH0: its change; H0_fixed_zstar: the Hubble constant that the same condition gives if the redshift of last scattering and the helium fraction are held at their values without deflation; theta_star_100; z_star; rs_star (Mpc); z_drag; rs_drag (Mpc); GN_star
column2: GN_early: Newton's constant at last scattering and in the early universe over its value today; Y_He: helium fraction (it responds to Newton's constant at nucleosynthesis); age_Gyr; tau0_Mpc: conformal age; sigma_8_M
column3: sigma_8_P; max_rel_TT: largest |TT/TT_0 - 1| for 30 <= l <= 2500 against the model without deflation; cv_max
column4: cv_rss: largest difference of TT in units of the cosmic variance of one multipole
column5: and the root of the sum of squares over 30 <= l <= 2500 (the last three for the closure "Momentum"); chi2_planck_M
column6: chi2_planck_P: chi^2 of the model against mock data of the fiducial model for the Planck-like data set of the main project
column8: closure_cv_high: largest difference between the temperature spectra of the two closures in units of the cosmic variance of one multipole
column9: for 2 <= l <= 29 and for 30 <= l <= 2500; closure_over_effect_low
column10: closure_over_effect_high: that difference relative to the effect of the deflation itself (roots of the sums of squares over the same ranges)
